subject: LumenWave discovery — deployment pathway recap & next steps
messages:
From: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: LumenWave discovery — initial recap and ask

Hi Mike / Sarah,

Thanks again for the call today — good conversation. Quick recap to make sure we captured the important constraints and to outline next steps so we can bring the right engineers to the deep-dive: 

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Interactive endpoint latency spikes during peak hours (current 95th ~ 800ms) causing degraded UX.
- Batch scoring windows (nightly reconciliation) need sustained throughput ~ 400-600 TPS for 30–60 minutes.
- Predictability and cost: want predictable unit economics for both interactive and batch workloads.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and VPC/private networking required for production.

Stated goals / success criteria:
- P95 interactive latency target <= 250ms for typical prompts (avg tokens/request ~ 150).
- Batch window throughput target 500 TPS sustained for 45 minutes at 4k token context.
- Ability to fallback to smaller/cheaper model in degraded capacity scenarios and routing by policy.

What we need from you to size a proposal:
1) A short sample of traffic (anonymized) that shows token distribution and request rate during peak and batch windows (CSV is fine).
2) Confirmation on acceptable model families (you mentioned testing 13B and 70B variants).
3) Any hard constraints on disk/ephemeral storage for KV cache or max per-request cost targets.

Attachments: you can drop the sample traffic to the shared Drive link (or attach directly). For today I pulled a quick skeleton CSV to illustrate the fields we need — I attached as lumenwave-traffic-sample.csv.

Next steps:
- If you're available, propose a 60–75 minute deep-dive with our infra/serving lead + model performance engineer next Wed (2026-09-16) or Thu (2026-09-17).
- We'll prepare an SLO matrix and a topology sketch (hosted / dedicated / private options) ahead of the call and send it for review.

I'll loop Marissa and Karthik into the deep-dive so they can propose the topology and preliminary sizing.

Best,
Rohan
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: lumenwave-traffic-sample.csv (CSV, anonymized token counts and timestamps)

Thanks Rohan — this is accurate and helpful. A couple clarifications: 

- The 500 TPS is a peak sustained target for our nightly reconciliation. Outside of that window interactive traffic is bursty: median ~ 8 TPS, but we see spikes to ~60 TPS for short periods.
- Token distribution: most requests are 50–200 tokens, but our reconciliation jobs can be 1k–4k tokens depending on batch.
- Model flavors: we are open to a hybrid approach — prefer starting with a strong open 13B for interactive, and a 70B (quantized) for higher-quality scoring in batch if cost allows.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is a hard requirement for production; we also need KMS integration for key material.

I'm attaching a short sample export from last week's batch window (anonymized). Happy to join the deep-dive next Wed afternoon.

—Mike

LumenWave

Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenWave discovery — deployment sketch + SLO matrix (draft)

Rohan / Karthik / Mike / Sarah — attaching a concise draft for the deep-dive. High-level summary and rationale below; see attached files: lumenwave-slo-matrix.xlsx and topology-sketch.png.

Executive summary (short):
- We propose an initial PoC with Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) sized for your nightly window, plus a smaller Hosted fallback for interactive spikes. If SOC 2 + KMS are required immediately, Private (VPC) is available for the production rollout — Private uses the same control plane but customer-managed networking and KMS integration.

Model guidance:
- Interactive: start with a quantized 13B (fp8/4-bit mixed where available) tuned for prompt templates; target fast KV cache hits for common prefixes. Expect median latency improvements ~2–3x vs non-quantized.
- Batch scoring: 70B quantized variant for highest-quality scoring; use batched synchronous workers to maximize throughput. When budget constrained, route lower priority batch to 13B ensemble for cheaper scoring.

Latency & throughput SLOs (proposal):
- Interactive (typical prompt length 150 tokens): p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 240ms, p99 <= 520ms (with KV cache warming and continuous batching).
- Batch scoring (4k token context): sustained throughput 500 TPS for 45 minutes; per-request latency expected 1.8–3.2s depending on quantization and batch size.

Topology / sizing sketch (ballpark):
- Dedicated pool option (recommended PoC): 8x A10G-equivalent nodes (or 4x A100-80GB for lower-concurrency, higher-single-request performance) with autoscaling headroom to cover 600 TPS burst for <15 mins.
- KV cache: dedicated SSD-backed cache per node, 200–400 GB total, key eviction policy tuned to prefix hit-rate.
- Routing policies: primary route to Dedicated pool (cost predictable), fallback to Hosted cheaper instances with lower QoS and lower model fidelity when Dedicated is at capacity.

Optimization knobs we will tune during PoC:
- Batch size and batching window for reconciliation jobs.
- Quantization level (4-bit vs 8-bit) and kernel selection for the 70B variant.
- Prefix/KV caching thresholds for interactive templates.

Deliverables for deep-dive / PoC kickoff:
- Final SLO matrix and topology (we attached drafts).
- A sample benchmark plan we can run against your anonymized traffic: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), token-cost, and throughput curves.
- A 2-week PoC plan: data requirements, access model (VPC/peering), and success criteria (p95 interactive < 250ms & batch sustained 500 TPS).

Action items (for LumenWave):
- Confirm which production constraint is non-negotiable (SOC 2, KMS, region).
- Drop the anonymized traffic sample to the Drive link or reply with attachments.
- Confirm best window for the 60–75m deep-dive on 2026-09-16 (I proposed 1:30–3:00 PM PDT).

I'll be on the call and will bring our serving lead. Karthik, please add any GPU sizing adjustments you think are required.

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
